about_short_description.short_description: Tachyon provides transport and logistics operations with the help of cloud-based logistics software.

product.name: Tachyon Transport Management System (TMS)
product.description: A cloud-based platform for managing transport and logistics operations, including booking, shipment assignment, tracking, and documentation.

product.name: Tachyon Driver Mobile App
product.description: A mobile application for drivers to receive orders, track shipments, report incidents, and manage delivery documentation in real time.

product.name: Tachyon Truck Aggregation Service
product.description: A service that aggregates a network of over 15,000 trucks, managing carrier pre-qualification, fixed price agreements, and insurance coverage.

identifier.value: Digital Document Management within Tachyon TMS

product.name: Digital Document Management within Tachyon TMS
product.description: A digital system for managing, storing, and sharing logistics documents such as shipping papers, invoices, and proof of delivery.

identifier.value: Real-Time Supply Chain Visibility and Tracking

product.name: Real-Time Supply Chain Visibility and Tracking
product.description: A technology-enabled service providing live tracking of shipments, route monitoring, and status updates using GPS, IoT sensors, and telematics.
